_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Woreyɛ Golf (Akwaduo mu) - Odwumayɛni {player_id}.
Botaeɛ: Nyaa akontabuo ketewa wɔ round yi mu. Sɛ kɔlɔm no kyerɛ sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a, wɔbɛtumi asi 0.
Kɔpɛ Mũ: A=1, 2-10=face value, J/Q=10, K=0

Nsɛm a wobɛyɛ (fa bracket a ɛwɔ mu no): 
- '[draw]' - Draw from deck
- '[take]' - Take from discard pile
- '[swap X Y]' - Swap drawn card with position X (row) Y (column)
- '[discard]' - Discard the drawn card

board.drew:
Woduu: {card}
Nia wɔ hɔ sɛ wotumi [swap X Y] anaa [discard] no.
board.took:
Wo fae: {card} firi sere a wosere no mu
 Wo behwe [swap X Y] ne no (wo ntumi nsere).

options.final_turns: Nkɔmhyɛ a etwa! Wo options: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Ɛsɛ sɛ: [swap X Y] (ntumi ntwe kaad no mfi nea wɔtow gu mu)
options.swap_or_discard: Wopɛ sɛ wotumi: [swap X Y] anaa [discard]

message.deck_empty: Nsaman no asa! Agorɔ no awie seisei.
message.knocked: Odwumfoɔ {pid} abɔ nkuku! Odwumfoɔ biara bɛnya turn baako.
message.final_round: Odwumfoɔ {pid} {reason}! Odwumfoɔ biara bɛnya turn baako.

invalid.wrong_action: Fa bracketed action baako pɛ: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], anaa [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Nneɛma a wɔtow gu no nni hɔ!
invalid.must_draw_first: Wo bɛbɔ [draw], [take], [knock], anaa [peek X Y] kan.
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Wuntumi ntwe kaade a wɔayi afi nea wɔde ato hɔ no mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ wosesa bi.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Woduu card. Wopɛ sɛ wotumi [swap X Y] anaa [discard] no.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Wuhia nkrataa a wɔatwa ato hɔ de asesa.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Wo hia karte a woapaw no sere.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Adansedi no abɔ ho ban. Fa row 1-{max_row}, column 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Wuntumi mfa krataa a wɔato no nto hɔ. Di kan yɛ nea wopɛ sɛ woyɛ ma awie wo bere so.
invalid.already_revealed: Wɔayi saa agyiraehyɛde no adi dedaw!
